newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH TRADE SECTOR 1997 PROFIT HOPES UP VS 1996.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH TRADE SECTOR 1997 PROFIT HOPES UP VS 1996.

text.p: The Finnish trade and commerce sector's earnings expectations for 1997 are better than a year ago, the Confederation of Service Industries said on Tuesday.
"The trade sector still sees improvement," confederation official Heikki Almgren told a news conference.
He referred to an annual autumn survey among service sector companies made in November.

According to the survey, 57 percent of wholesale and retail companies expected profitability to improve in 1997, 30 percent expected profitability to remain unchanged and 12 percent expected it to deteriorate.
In the autumn of 1995 survey 46 percent of the companies expected profitability to improve.
